summary: CorrespondenceHistory is a feature in the HSPnet web application that manages and displays the history of actions performed on correspondence records. It supports searching, viewing, and generating history entries. The UI includes controls for error/warning panels, searching, printing, and displaying correspondence details. The business logic is implemented in both page-level and user control code, connecting data access, workflow, and validation.
purpose: To provide a record and audit trail of actions performed on correspondence, including generated correspondence, edits, and summary views. The feature supports user interaction, error handling, and maintains agency and user-related details.

workflows.name: View Correspondence History
steps: User requests the CorrespondenceHistory page with parameters (CorrespondenceID, HistoryType) from query string.
Page_Load validates the URL hash and sets up the page.
On first load, sets page title based on HistoryType and loads CorrespondenceHistory user control.
User control receives UserSession, CorrespondenceID, HistoryType, and RefreshBtns flag.
User control binds data using ObjectDataSource; only proceeds if UserSession is valid.
Displays correspondence history in grid; shows reference details and refresh buttons.

workflows.name: Add Correspondence History Entry
steps: Procedure CorrespondenceHistoryAdd is called with SessionID, CorrespondenceID, ScreenSection, UserAction, Fields, ScreenSectionAlt, UserActionAlt, FieldsAlt.
Correspondence history entry is created for 'Generate' action (English and French).
Database query executed to add entry.

workflows.name: Search Correspondence History
steps: For each entry, fields are populated and added to result list.

business_rules: HistoryType determines page title and what actions/entries are displayed (Content, Generate, Summary).
UserSession must be valid for history search and display.
AgencyUserFormatted logic: If user is not sysadmin and original user differs, prepend support team caption.
Entries use both English and French fields depending on language preference.
validations: URL hash must be validated before loading page.
CorrespondenceID must be valid (>0) when adding history.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted combines agency, user's initials, and conditional support team caption.
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted combines formatted name, agency, and phone as tooltip.
conditions: HistoryType == 'Content', 'Generate', or 'Summary' for different display logic.
If user is not sysadmin and user IDs differ, support team caption is shown.
Use AltLanguage fields if session requires alternate language.
system_behavior: Auto-generated controls are declared for UI panels, grids, labels, and hidden fields.
CorrespondenceHistory user control refreshes data and buttons based on flags.
Redirect logic for search based on configuration (USE_YARP).
Error and warning panels can be hidden via UI buttons.
dependencies: Database access via stored procedures (CorrespondenceHistorySearch, CorrespondenceHistoryAdd)
UI controls (Panels, GridView, Labels, ScriptManager, AlwaysVisibleControlExtender, UserControl)
Resources for localization (English and French labels, captions)
exceptions: If UserSession is null, ObjectDataSource cancels selection.
content_gaps: No details on error/warning message formats or exact grid columns.
Database schema for stored procedures is not included.
Not all business rules are explicit (some inferred).
